name: The Sundial of Shifting Seasons
description: An enormous stone sundial in a mystical clearing where each hour represents a different season, with spring flowers blooming and autumn leaves falling simultaneously.
prompt: A massive ancient stone sundial standing in a circular clearing where time flows differently. At the center, a crystalline gnomon casts shadows that shift through all four seasons simultaneously - spring blossoms bloom at dawn positions, summer warmth radiates midday, autumn leaves fall in afternoon light, winter frost sparkles at dusk. Around the dial, seasonal plants grow in harmony - cherry trees next to pine, sunflowers beside snowdrops. Ethereal lighting, magical realism, detailed botanical illustration style.
caption: Time doesn't move in straight lines here - it spirals through seasons in a single day. ⏳🌸
